calibration: None; fixed raw .8 confidence diagnostic only, no tuning on internal eval; deployed acceptance always zero
group_definition: Preserve worker-assigned train/eval groups; add exact delexicalized raw-source skeleton unions, including masked aliases; crossing assigned partitions fails closed. No independent/IID ancestry proof.

hyperparameters.loss: mean across within-corpus canonical groups then their observed rows; no class weights

objective: 77-way publisher-intent auxiliary cross-entropy; learned representation/routing only; no policy adaptation, collection consent, amounts, tools or permission labels
quantization: Round exported coefficients to8 decimal places; report native full-precision vs stdlib exported score maxerror, decoder mismatches and persistence equality

invariants.limits: Regex scrubbing is heuristic; it does not certify absence of all names, indirect identifiers, paraphrase leakage, or unannotated shared conversations.

source.attribution: PolyAI; Inigo Casanueva, Tadas Temcinas, Daniela Gerz, Matthew Henderson and Ivan Vulic (2020), Efficient Intent Detection with Dual Sentence Encoders

split_method.method: stratified per-label hash ordering of delexicalized roots before 80/10/10 allocation
